notes: When Claude connects it reads your EZtakeoff skills first and tells you which ones; it can't change a job until it has, and the bottom bar shows what it read. The Rules for Claude box is gone from Settings: rules for every job go in your skill. Material is one drop-down with its icon colour, and the caption's Turn is now Rotate. Notes for Claude are placed like Claude's questions, with more pin options and a box that drags on its own.
